toolOutage.scope: WebFetch in this routine's cloud sandbox resolves only the www.anthropic.com apex. Every other domain tested fails DNS resolution (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND) — job boards (greenhouse.io, ashbyhq.com) and company sites (databricks.com). This includes Anthropic's own job-detail pages, which live on job-boards.greenhouse.io and are therefore unreachable even though anthropic.com itself resolves and loads.
toolOutage.persistence: Confirmed present again today, 2026-10-16, identical in shape to every prior day's report going back to mid-July 2026 — now over 3 months unresolved despite being reported in the searchLog every single day.
toolOutage.likelyImpact: Zero opportunities can be verified from any company's actual careers/application page except Anthropic's top-level listing (which has no usable new-grad roles for Dom's target families and whose individual postings are unreachable anyway). This has been the actual cause of the 3+ month run of zero verified opportunities, not a lack of real leads.
toolOutage.fix: This is an environment/network-policy (egress allowlist) setting for the life-hub-daily / hunt routine's cloud sandbox, not something fixable from inside the session. It needs widening to at least standard job-board domains (greenhouse.io, ashbyhq.com, lever.co, myworkday.com, workable.com) plus the specific company domains in data/target-companies.json. Checked the agent proxy status endpoint today: proxy itself is healthy (enabled, CA bundle covers every host, zero relay failures) — this is a DNS allowlist gap upstream of the proxy, not a proxy or cert misconfiguration. Three+ months of daily reports haven't self-resolved it, and this gap has never been written into the life hub's TODO.md or LOG.md (life/ is read-only from this session), so it may still not be on Dom's radar as a standing issue to fix.
